name: Bedroom Setup
title: Set the bedroom cold, dark, and quiet.
subtitle: Sleep Environment
rationale: Heat and light disrupt sleep stages, so fixing the room once removes the problem permanently without willpower.

evidence.summary: Thermal environment research shows heat exposure and light disrupt sleep stages; roughly 18-20°C, blackout, and quiet support deeper sleep.

indications: The bedroom runs warm or lets in street light.
Night waking clusters in the early morning hours.
